reference: original 1H OHLC inferred-path profit BTC +4298.1778 / ETH +6773.09
metrics: BTC literal $100/$200 price points; ETH 0.125%/0.25% of own entry (100/200 BTC-equivalent), not literal $100/$200

BTC.reach_definition: Modeled maximum favorable excursion before assumed exit, from original hourly OHLC-inferred-path replay (pos.best plus favorable exit gap). For ETH use 100/200 BTC-equivalent points = 0.125%/0.25% of trade entry price, not fixed $100/$200.
BTC.realized_definition: Gross directional price-point difference entry vs exit, disregards fees, margin and leverage.
BTC.caveat: MFE is reconstructed from the original OHLC-inferred (not observed tick) path; possible high/low sequence uncertainty and unrealistic sub-tick trailing profits. This is NOT evidence the original +$4,298/+6,773 were achievable.
